scientific_integrity: An analytic spectral optimization proof; independent audit has not been performed. No claim of priority or exhaustive search is made.
scientific_limitations: Global minimal SLEM is proved, but all non-invariant optimizer matrices are not classified.
Uniqueness applies to the two hub-edge types in the invariant family, not to all permitted edge probabilities.
Earlier undated public drafts may precede the day-verified 2004 article.
title: Sharp fastest-mixing transition on pineapple graphs
